reason: The rational-residue, factorization, polarization, and constant-function arguments are sound. The proposition keeps current conservation as an explicit hypothesis, so it does not extend the published real, positive-mass Ward result to complex null momenta. Two local repairs remain.

findings.reason: The definition assigns a spinor-helicity equivalence class to every rank-one matrix and says the next lemma establishes existence and uniqueness, but lacks a justified_by link to lem-qftx-spinor-factorization, which proves that well-definedness. Add that same-page relation; the lemma already depends on this definition.

The remark that any nonzero local quartic contact term has a constant shifted coefficient is too broad: derivative interactions can depend on shifted momenta. The cited §2.3 example is the derivative-free λ|φ|⁴ interaction. Qualify the remark to that example or to the explicitly stipulated constant coefficient.
